source_to_record.source_anchor_editorial_summary: Continuation: significator sign's quarter locates place in town
Moon eastern/western celestial quarter places gate on east/west side
Moon movable — door reached up steps
Saturn aspects sign — old/broken/black gate; Mars increases damage
Moon small of light under adverse aspect — little apparent ironwork
Are the goods in the owner's hands? — heading
Ascendant lord angular — goods in owner's hands
Hour lord angular — same custody testimony
Moon's house lord with hour lord angular — movable goods in hands
Hour lord, Moon term lord, second lord angular with first lord — fixed goods
Those lords angular and square/trine/sextile to first lord — recovery
First lord and hour lord succedent — goods near owner
Moon or Moon house lord in movable sign — goods nearby
Moon term ruler or second ruler succedent — goods near
Same enumerated rulers cadent — goods far from owner
Whether goods remain in thief's custody — heading
Thief significator transfers its power — not kept by thief
Thief significator does not transfer power — retained in custody

source_scope_note: Printed page's final catchword does not become a new rule; retain alternatives in separate owner-near and thief-custody sections.
